subject: Your MaiAn employee account has been activated
title: Please log in and change your password as soon as possible
content:
Dear {employeeName}, your employee account at {companyName} has been successfully created and activated. Your login email is: {email}.
To help you get started, the system has generated a temporary password: {temporaryPassword}
ignore: For your security, please change your password immediately after your first login. If you did not register on the MaiAn platform, please ignore this email.
support: If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact our support team at any time. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
